narrative: Constructed; maximal contrast (loud, kinetic, dense, vivid). Former D1 sprinter training 13-18-year-olds; sells to two audiences at once — parents (trust) and athletes (belonging). Gym-floor energy, short sentences, calls everyone 'fam'. Resulting direction: a stadium scoreboard crossed with a mixtape — vivid, kinetic, statistically proud — with one calm lane for parents. Opposite of E2 on every axis.

evidence: I see the athlete they haven't met yet
they're hungry — they want the next level
every gym is red-and-black aggression; we're not angry, we're ALIVE

summary_for_practitioner: Your site hits like a scoreboard the second it loads: a dark court with electric-lime energy, condensed jersey-type headlines, and PR numbers that race upward on entry — because the program is about measurable next-level progress. The athletes are the subject in real training footage; you show up mid-coaching, alongside them. And there's one calm, readable lane built just for parents to find the schedule and trust the structure.
